title: OK but not great
text: OK but not great. OK but not great. I like the length compared to others, but these are rather cheaply stamped with a pretty dull finish. They seem just a bit lighter gauge than I'd prefer and I question how durable they will be. As a seafood fork, they seem OK. The design works pretty well for cracking shells using the tine gap like a can opener.  They don't nest well in each other, somewhat inconsistently shaped. I suspect they will bend pretty easily. They look cheaply made but the price is higher than much nicer 5 inch competitors. I was hoping to use these much like a granny fork or small carving fork for plating meats. good length and the tine gap should fit most small carving knives, but just not quite what I wanted, although they should work as seafood forks. I may end up repurposing these for some tool usage, hammering and grinding them into some specialized tool shape.

description: Crab and lobster lovers, don't let any of that hard-to-reach meat go to waste. Nantucket Seafood's set of 2 Lobster Forks are perfect for extracting all the delicious goodies inside shellfish. Constructed of sturdy stainless steel with an elegant design, these handy tools feature a sharp, two tined fork on one end to fit into the smallest part of the crab and a spoon on the opposite end to scrape, pull, or scoop the meat out. Great for smaller shellfish, as well as for reaching into the furthest end of lobster legs due to its long length of 8. 25 inches. Easy to clean, hand wash recommended. Make sure you're properly equipped for your next crab fest, lobster fest, or seafood feast, and leave no goodness behind.
